subject: Changing span doesn't seem to change smoothed line?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Changing span doesn't seem to change smoothed line?
parts:
Hi,

It seems strange to me that changing the span parameter doesn't help
the smoothed curve. I'm afraid that I did something wrong, as the
smoothed curve seem to be very different from the points. Could
anybody take a look and see if there is anything wrong with my code?

> qplot(dist, count, data=fdisto5, geom=c('point', 'smooth'), span=.0001)
> qplot(dist, count, data=fdisto5, geom=c('point', 'smooth'), span=.01)
> qplot(dist, count, data=fdisto5, geom=c('point', 'smooth'), span=.1)
> qplot(dist, count, data=fdisto5, geom=c('point', 'smooth'), span=1)

The data is here. Thanks!

https://rapidshare.com/files/2958722910/fdisto5.RData

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Changing span doesn't seem to change smoothed line?
parts:
It works if you pass the span argument through geom_smooth() of qlot(), i.e.,

qplot(dist, count, data=fdisto5, 'point') +
geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.1)

Best,
Ista

messages.subject: Re: Changing span doesn't seem to change smoothed line?
parts:
Hi Ista,

This seems strange. The following code works just fine when span is
specified in qplot.

library(ggplot2)
x=1:100
dfr=data.frame(x, y=x+rnorm(100,0,100))

qplot(x, y, data=dfr, geom=c('point', 'smooth'))
qplot(x, y, data=dfr, geom=c('point', 'smooth'), span=.1)
qplot(x, y, data=dfr, geom=c('point', 'smooth'), span=.5)
qplot(x, y, data=dfr, geom=c('point', 'smooth'), span=1)

What is wrong with the following command?
